name: FCA Conduct of Business Sourcebook Part 2 (Complaints)

properties.core_policy_statement: FirstUK Bank is committed to handling customer complaints fairly, efficiently, and in accordance with FCA requirements.
properties.scope_summary: Procedures for complaint receipt, investigation, resolution, and regulatory reporting.

properties.core_policy_statement: To establish complaint handling procedures that acknowledge all complaints promptly, investigate issues thoroughly, resolve complaints fairly, report to FCA as required, prevent repeat issues, and maintain customer relationships.

name: Regulatory Reporting of Complaints to FCA

rights_under_policy: Prompt acknowledgement of complaints
Thorough investigation of issues
Fair resolution of complaints

properties.scope_summary: Applies to all customer complaints regarding products, services, and policies across all channels (branch, phone, email, online), involving all staff, accounts, and products.

specific_obligations: Compliance with the Customer Complaints Policy

rights_under_policy: Ability to lodge complaints via branch, phone, email, or online channels

properties.core_policy_statement: FirstUK Bank treats all customer complaints seriously and resolves them fairly within regulatory timeframes.

name: Fair and Timely Resolution of Customer Complaints

specific_obligations: Adhere to regulatory timeframes for resolution
properties.accountability_for: Fair and timely resolution of customer complaints

rights_under_policy: Right to have complaints treated seriously
Right to fair resolution
Right to resolution within regulatory timeframes

properties.core_policy_statement: Defines a complaint as any expression of dissatisfaction by a customer regarding FirstUK Bank's service or product.

rights_under_policy: Ability to express dissatisfaction regarding bank services or products

properties.risk_definition: Complaints relating to the quality and delivery of banking services
Complaints relating to the specific features, terms, or administration of banking products
Risks resulting in a direct monetary loss to the customer or bank

suspicious_indicators: Transaction not initiated by the account holder
Deceptive or illegal activity intended for financial gain

Determine if FirstUK Bank is at fault

rights_under_policy: Choice of response delivery method (Email or Letter)
Right to escalate the complaint

properties.core_policy_statement: Establishment of maximum response timeframes for simple, standard, and complex complaints to ensure regulatory compliance with FCA requirements.

properties.exceptions: Justified complex investigation and customer agreement

Right to agree or disagree to investigation extensions

properties.core_policy_statement: Establishment of categories and procedures for the investigation, resolution, and learning from customer complaints, specifically regarding service failures.

properties.risk_definition: Failures in the delivery of banking services leading to customer dissatisfaction

properties.verification_method: Review of timeline, procedure adherence, reasonableness assessment, and staff interviews

properties.applies_to: Complaints where the bank is found to be at fault

properties.key_obligation: Implement process improvements to prevent recurrence of the service failure

properties.scope_summary: Handling of unexpected charges, overdraft fees, and card replacement fees
properties.core_policy_statement: Fees must be investigated against terms and conditions and customer history to determine if they were applied correctly and disclosed clearly.

rights_under_policy: Right to investigation of disputed fees
Right to refund and apology if T&Cs are unclear
Right to reversal of charges and interest in case of bank error

properties.risk_classification: Subject to card replacement fee disputes

properties.scope_summary: Handling of missing credits, incorrect balances, and interest miscalculations
properties.core_policy_statement: Ensure accurate account balances through systematic investigation and remediation of discrepancies, whether caused by bank error, system failure, or customer misunderstanding.

properties.required_response: Explain the balance to the customer
exceptions: Do not penalize the customer for misunderstandings

name: Urgent IT Escalation for System Errors

properties.required_response: Urgent escalation to fix the system error

rights_under_policy: Right to balance correction
Right to interest on missing amounts due to bank error
Right to education regarding balance misunderstandings

properties.verification_method: Further investigation

properties.risk_definition: Transactions claimed by the customer to be fraudulent or unauthorized
properties.required_response: Investigation by Fraud Team and assessment of fraud likelihood

properties.authority: Determine if fraud is confirmed or if customer is liable

Educational explanation if found liable

properties.required_response: Review transaction details and verify authorization

properties.scope_summary: Management and resolution of Account Takeover scenarios where customers discover accounts used without permission.
properties.core_policy_statement: The bank shall investigate unauthorized account access through immediate freezing and review, and resolve the issue via reimbursement and security resets.

examples: Customer discovers account used without permission

name: Immediate Account Freeze upon Unauthorized Access

specific_obligations: Handle escalations for unauthorized account access investigations
Receive notification of unauthorized access if warranted

rights_under_policy: Full reimbursement of fraudulent transactions
Credit monitoring in cases of identity theft

properties.freeze_conditions: Discovery of account use without permission

properties.core_policy_statement: Establishment of a tiered escalation matrix based on severity, financial value, and involvement to ensure timely resolution of customer complaints.

properties.risk_definition: Risks associated with major failures or public perception

specific_obligations: Resolve simple, low-value complaints within 1 day
Resolve moderate issues with <£500 loss within 5 days
Resolve significant issues with >£500 loss within 8 days
Handle major failures and reputational risks within 8+ weeks

rights_under_policy: Right to escalate to FCA

properties.core_policy_statement: Guidelines for providing financial compensation to customers based on service delays, failures, financial loss, and serious distress, with a defined approval hierarchy based on payment value.

specific_obligations: Receive notification for compensation payments exceeding £1,000

rights_under_policy: Entitled to compensation for service delays, failures, financial loss, and serious distress

Review quarterly reports on volume trends, top complaint types, systemic issues, and corrective actions

properties.required_response: Improve T&C clarity and enhance disclosure
